_comment: Orchestration metrics/telemetry. DEFAULT ENABLED: feeds the orchestration displays and distributed scale-down negotiation (rolling + initial performance figures). One-switch 'turbo button' disables all collection for max performance. Local-only; nothing leaves the swarm. See docs/metrics-and-turbo.md.

turbo_button._desc: Set turbo:true (or env FAMILIA_TURBO=1 / serve.sh --turbo) to disable ALL metrics collection for maximum performance. Overrides enabled.

scale_down_negotiation._desc: Nodes negotiate the work split from rolling + initial performance figures; updated as models/engines/microcode change.
